queries.Q25_why_evolve_the_ladder_shape: MEASURED: after the EDGE-CURE freed the mine capital (~13.7 SBD), the old 2×0.25 SBD buy shape put only 0.5 SBD back to work per run — the freed capital sat idle while the capture is the binding (R31: fill-through 21.5% of capacity). The evolved shape — 3 sells + 3 buys × 0.5 SBD = exactly MAX_NEW_ORDERS — triples the buy exposure and doubles the touch-levels inside the same six-order ceiling. The cap law, the band law and the STACK-EXISTS law are untouched; the E28 SBD-cap pin EVOLVED WITH THE DESK (0.3 SBD funds zero buys, 1.2 SBD funds exactly two — the granularity is now 0.5).
queries.Q26_what_sets_the_sovereign_cadence: THE MEASURED FILL CADENCE: capture measured 106-124 fills/day ≈ one fill per 12-13 minutes — a 15-min beat re-armed slower than the flow it chases. The heartbeat evolves to 600s and the LIVE cooldown to 10 min (the beat ≈ the fill interval; the loop re-arms inside one fill-interval). The cooldown law itself is unchanged: one LIVE arm per window, a denied arm is a booked row.
queries.Q27_when_does_the_first_positive_cycle_b: NO CODE NEEDED — the proof surface already waits for the chain: pnl-book's edgeLawHolds flips to true the moment post-cure fills close a cycle with edge ≥ 0, and the dashboard badge flips with it. The engine's job (R34) is to make fills ARRIVE: more levels, bigger sizes, faster re-arm — all inside the caps and the VWAP law. The powerdown (476 SP/week from 2026-10-10) keeps growing the working capital the ladder stands on.
queries.Q28_coordination_to_sibling_lanes: THE EVOLVED SHAPE IS FLEET-WIDE: sells 3 / buys 3 × 0.5 SBD per run, MAX_NEW_ORDERS=6 unchanged; DRY planning receipts stay free for every lane; the heartbeat owns LIVE (do not double-run market-exec LIVE — DELEGATION-SELECTION law); the EDGE-CURE cancels any of our buys above sellVwap×0.997 every LIVE pass — do not re-place above the cap. CR-0062's Q20 standing-depth rung stays open for the HE basket.
